messages:
maya: Quick sync — during the staged canary mixing FlashAttention v2 and v3 we saw a 6–12% p95 regression on short-seq (<=64) chat completions when KV paging is enabled. Not a full outage but reproducible in perf runs.
kevin: ack. Which canary cohort was this on? and do we have profiler traces?
maya: Canary id c-2026-03-14-3, traffic routed to v3 kernels for 30% of requests. Attached a short perf dump:
```
[profile] cohort=c-2026-03-14-3
metric: p95_latency_ms
seq_len<=64: baseline(FAv2)=42ms, mix(FAv2/FAv3/paged_kv)=47ms (+11.9%)
seq_len>256: baseline=310ms, mix=295ms (-4.8%)
cpu/gpu: increased SM memory stalls on v3 path for short seqs
KV pages touched: increases from 1.2 -> 2.7 per request in mixed path
```
anita: interesting — short sequences regressing while long sequences improve. That smells like v3's tiling for large seqs helps but its microkernel is thrashing small-L2 caches when paging KV.
lucas: do we have a repro that toggles only the kernel variant without changing batching heuristics? need to isolate.
maya: yes, ran unit profile where we switched kernel selector only (no batching change). Same trend. I also captured a nvprof snippet showing higher L2 miss rate on v3 for key ops.
kevin: can you paste the nvprof snippet?
maya:
```
GPU L2 hit_rate: FAv2 kernel path = 0.78
GPU L2 hit_rate: FAv3 kernel path = 0.62
SM occupancy similar. v3 issues occur on small head dims with paged KV active.
```
anita: ok so KV paging + v3 microkernel yields worse locality for small sequences. Two immediate options:
  1) Add selector rule: when seq_len<=64 && KV_paging==on -> prefer FAv2
  2) Improve v3 microkernel (longer term) or change page prefetching behavior
lucas: I like 1) for safety. We should implement via feature-flagged selector so ops can flip quickly.
kevin: agree. Add telemetry so we can measure impact — record tag: attn_kernel_forced=fav2_on_smallseq_kv. Also need a guardrail for regressions (auto-rollback threshold).
maya: proposed flag name: ff/attn/kernel/force_v2_for_smallseq_pagedkv. default=false. rollout plan: enable for canary cohort first.
deploy-bot: Canary c-2026-03-14-3 deployment completed at 2026-03-14T15:22:11Z (route: 30%) :rocket:
kevin: suggested selector pseudocode:
```
if seq_len <= 64 and kv_paging_enabled:
  choose_kernel = FAv2
elif seq_len >= 512:
  choose_kernel = FAv3_tiled
else:
  choose_kernel = default_cost_model_choice
```
anita: also add a soft fallback: if v3 latency > v2_latency_sampled by >10% over last 1m then route to v2 for that model-version. helps live regression protection.
lucas: how do we surface this in Console? we need a per-model dashboard card showing kernel mix, p50/p95 per kernel, and KV page counts.
maya: I'll add a telemetry tag: kernel_variant, kv_pages, seq_len_bucket, batch_size. We'll emit histograms.
kevin: testing checklist before flipping the flag to broader traffic:
  - unit perf tests (short seqs + paged KV) pass with no regression after selector change
  - canary 1% for 30m, collect metrics
  - canary 5% for 1h, collect and compare p95 vs baseline
  - autoscale and memory pressure smoke test
anita: set rollback criteria: if p95 increases >5% for seq_len<=64 OR error-rate delta >0.1% then rollback flag.
maya: I'll create the ff and a quick proto selector in runtime. Planning to land in a small PR (runtime + telemetry) and then staged flip.
lucas: FYI for on-prem/private customers we should make the selector configurable via instance config so it doesn't surprise them.
kevin: good call. add config knob and document in release notes.
maya: PR draft: runtime: add selector, telemetry tags; ops: runbook for rollback; devex: console card ticket. Target: roll to 1% canary tomorrow at 10:00 PT.
deploy-bot: ff service: flag ff/attn/kernel/force_v2_for_smallseq_pagedkv created (owner: maya).
kevin: for postmortem-level traceability, capture a sample of request ids that hit the regression and store full kernel selection logs for 24h.
maya: will add sampling at 0.1% and log to ephemeral S3 bucket with retention 7d.
anita: long-term: open issue to optimize v3 microkernel memory access pattern for paged KV — I'll file it and tag perf/research.
lucas: any experiments we can run now to test prefetching knobs? maybe reduce page size or prefetch depth?
maya: I ran one: lowering prefetch depth from 4 -> 1 reduced L2 misses but increased average KV fetch latency; net effect was neutral on overall p95 for short seqs. Still worth exploring.
kevin: ok steps: maya creates PR + ff, land selector, run canary per checklist, ops monitor, rollback on thresholds. After stable, iterate on v3 microkernel.
anita: thanks everyone. I'll own the long-term perf ticket. :white_check_mark:
maya: I'll post the PR link in this thread and ping ops when ready for canary.
kevin: 👍
